method_selection.citation: standard hyperparameter search practice (random/grid search, Bergstra & Bengio JMLR 2012); package composition per DCNv2/BPR training setups.
method_selection.why: Training loss continues falling while validation primary peaks at epoch 8 and declines through epoch 10, indicating overfit. This card implements the literature-grounded DCN-lite, hybrid-BPR, regularization-schedule, and recency package as a unit, which is essential on this small temporal dataset because bare capacity and isolated objective changes have measured poorly. Its wide random dial search and half-epoch validation-best checkpointing directly address the curve shape, while the package has a replicated ~0.6047 reference level—an honest gain near +0.0029 over the 0.6018 parent and large enough to justify this early iteration.

rejected.reason: It offers cleaner component attribution, but the campaign already has replicated evidence that the components interact and that several atoms fail alone; its much higher runtime has lower immediate artifact value than reproducing and tuning the complete package.
Its precondition is not met: there is not yet an accepted tuned-package champion in this lineage.
Ensembling is a closing move and was already tried prematurely in the prior run; first establish a reproducible competitive single-model package.
It targets overfit but has an uncertain sub-noise expected gain, whereas the package has replicated benchmark evidence and includes the required coherent regularization stack.

expected_delta_basis: The selected package card reports 0.6047 +/- 0.0003 for tuned capacity and regularization versus the 0.6018 parent, while noting untuned settings fall to 0.595-0.602 and therefore require a broad dial search.

method_selection.citation: factorial experiment design (Fisher; standard DOE practice); ablation-study methodology.
method_selection.why: Validation peaks at epoch 3 and then declines while training loss keeps falling, indicating overfit. The failed node_001 bundled architecture, objective, recency, and regularization, so its 0.5998 result cannot identify which component or interaction failed. This cross-stage matrix directly supplies the requested controlled ablations, including the full package and component dropouts, followed by full-fidelity training and half-epoch checkpoint selection. Its expected score gain over the accepted 0.6036 parent is honestly modest—roughly 0.001 to 0.002 from campaign evidence—but it has higher scientific value and a better chance of finding a productive interaction than another unsupported atomic rider.

rejected.reason: It would retest another bundled package after node_001 without first isolating the harmful component, repeating the attribution problem identified in the journal critique.

The auxiliary bundle is unmeasured on this lineage and should be tested after establishing a stable regularized stack; its reported +0.003 includes a confounded architecture change and some required targets may be unavailable.
A closing ensemble was already attempted and rejected, and ensembling now would compound uncertainty before identifying a reproducible competitive single-model configuration.

expected_delta_basis: The selected factorial-design card reports a tuned best near 0.6047, about 0.0011 above the accepted parent primary of 0.6036, while warning that this gain is below the 0.002 noise threshold.
